active.summary: [AB] Free Shipping Threshold Banner on Cart
active.brief:
Summary
Sample Retail Co Online Store visitors currently see a standard experience for "Free Shipping Threshold Banner on Cart". The team believes a focused change here will reduce friction and raise conversion for first-time visitors. Baseline metrics are directionally available from the analytics dashboard, and confidence is rated high.
Hypothesis
By introducing "Free Shipping Threshold Banner on Cart" for eligible Online Store visitors, we will reduce friction and raise conversion for first-time visitors, because the current experience gives shoppers little guidance at this decision point, leading to a measurable lift in the primary conversion metric.
Context
Business context: Sample Retail Co is prioritizing Online Store improvements this quarter. This request was submitted through the intake form and reviewed in weekly triage. Primary metric: conversion rate; secondary metrics: revenue per visitor and bounce rate. Audience: all eligible visitors unless otherwise noted. Any required copy or creative will be provided by the design team before development starts.
